# Time Picker

The `Time Picker` allows you to enter an exact time.
See [Date & Time Picker guidelines<i className="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/date-time-picker.html#hour)

* Any other props supplied will be provided to the root element
* For details on CSS styles, see [CSS implementation](https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system/blob/develop/packages/styles/src/elements/DatePicker/index.ts)

## Examples

### Period

Allow user to choose from “AM” to “PM”.<br />
The value will be in the form `hh:mm am` or `hh:mm pm`.
